name: example-readonly
description: Read-only GitHub public-API CLI — the template for a read-only belt tool: in-code limit ceiling, --explain pre-flight, audit line, optional token from env or a 600-mode file
surface: read-only CLI; GET only, no write code exists

origin.note: authored in this kit as the read-only example

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional GitHub token; raises the rate limit from 60 to 5000 req/hr. Alternative: ~/.config/exr/token mode 600

auth.flow: Optional personal access token from $GITHUB_TOKEN or a 600-mode key file; unauthenticated reads work out of the box at GitHub's 60 req/hr
auth.login: Create a fine-grained personal access token in GitHub (Settings > Developer settings) with no write permissions; export GITHUB_TOKEN or write it to ~/.config/exr/token (chmod 600)

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file; exr refuses group/world-readable permissions
caches.revoke: Delete the token in GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens

safeguards: Read-only by construction: every request is a GET and no write code exists (SENSIBILITIES #1)
Hard 100-item --limit ceiling and 10-item default — code constants in exr.mjs, not flags; a higher --limit is refused, not lowered (SENSIBILITIES #3)
--explain pre-flight prints the exact URL and headers with the token redacted, and makes no call (SENSIBILITIES #5)
Audit line to stderr per call: timestamp, verb, target — never the token (SENSIBILITIES #7)
20s request timeout; rate limit, 404 and network failure each get a plain message and exit 1, no retries (SENSIBILITIES #8)
Token from $GITHUB_TOKEN or ~/.config/exr/token only; a group/world-readable key file is refused; the token is never printed or logged (SENSIBILITIES #11)

verbs.name: repo
verbs.note: stars, forks, open issues, default branch, pushed_at for one owner/name

verbs.name: releases
verbs.note: most recent releases; --limit N up to the 100 ceiling, default 10

verbs.name: search
verbs.note: repository search; GitHub's own search rate limit is 10/min unauthenticated

verbs.name: any GitHub write (issues, PRs, stars, repos, releases)
verbs.note: no write code exists; every request is a GET

risk.worst_case: spends the operator's GitHub rate-limit budget (60/hr unauthenticated, 5000/hr with a token) on public reads capped at 100 items each

checks.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
checks.label: GitHub token present (optional — raises the rate limit)
checks.fix: Optional: export GITHUB_TOKEN or write a token to ~/.config/exr/token (chmod 600). Without one, exr works at 60 req/hr

smoke_test.command: node exr.mjs repo octocat/Hello-World --explain && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: pre-flight renders the request without calling GitHub; unit tests green
